content.text:
The robot found the red ball, walked up to it and stopped facing it. I then called rest.

The last camera image shows the ball roughly centered in front of the robot, a few tens of centimetres away. I didn't measure the exact distance.

During the approach, collision protection stopped the walk twice. Each time I continued with short steps and corrected the heading until the ball was centered.
